description: This file defines the Attendance class and related functions for managing employee attendance records in an ERP system, including validation, event retrieval, and bulk operations.

classes.name: Attendance
classes.description: Represents an employee's attendance record with validation and leave checking methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the attendance record before saving.

methods.name: validate_attendance_date
methods.description: Validates that the attendance date is not in the future or before the employee's joining date.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_record
methods.description: Checks for duplicate attendance records for the same employee and date.

methods.name: validate_employee_status
methods.description: Ensures the employee is active before marking attendance.

methods.name: check_leave_record
methods.description: Checks if the employee has an approved leave on the attendance date and updates status accordingly.

methods.name: validate_employee
methods.description: Validates that the employee exists and is active.
